caveats: Land/ice cells with NaN in baseline pool get NaN threshold and are never hot. Sea cells defined by target period only. Region has 60x60 cells (lat 58.70-59.88, lon 18.70-19.88, all within bounds). No per-cell MHW formed: the longest hot run in any sea cell over June-August 2017 was 4 days, below the 5-day minimum. Mask is all zeros as a result.
